interface.title: MSEABOARD
interface.stage_of_work: exploratory analysis and visual inspection of alignments, trees, distance matrices and structures
interface.what_it_is_for: A browser canvas of resizable panels where alignments, trees, distance matrices, per-site data and 3D protein structures are loaded, linked so hovering one highlights the matching element in the others, and turned into new linked panels (translation, distance matrices, FastME/NJ trees, logos, site statistics, dN/dS predictions).

data.note: Uploaded vertebrate_gene.fasta (6 taxa, 42 nt; Mouse has an N at position 24 and Rat has a 6-nt gap), vertebrate_gene.nwk (the reference tree), vertebrate_gene_distance.dist, mini_peptide.pdb and vertebrate_gc_content.tsv. The TSV has no header row, so the first row (Human 0.512) was taken as the column headers. The .dist file labels the chimpanzee 'Chimp', while the FASTA and tree say 'Chimpanzee'. The tree that FastME builds from the alignment is also named vertebrate_gene.nwk; it is called 'the FastME tree' below to keep it apart from the uploaded reference tree. I did not use the example boards.

features.name: Cross-panel linked hover highlighting
features.general: Link two views of the same items and hover an item in either view to highlight its match in the other
features.specific: Press the chain-link button on one panel and then the target panel's link button. Linked panels get matching coloured dots. Hovering a row, leaf, column, bar or cell then highlights the matching row, leaf, codon, site, bar or residue in every linked panel. Matching uses exact taxon names: 'Chimp' in the uploaded .dist file did not match 'Chimpanzee' in the tree.
steps: press Link panel on the source panel
click the target panel's link button (colored dots appear)
hover a sequence row, column or heatmap cell
see matching leaf, codon bar or protein site highlighted (names must match exactly)
hover a tree leaf to highlight the row in reverse
serves_tasks: Link alignment rows to tree leaves and check highlighting in both directions
Follow one site through all derived views
Link a distance heatmap to the reference tree

features.name: Tree editor with prune, reroot and subtree extraction
features.general: Edit a hierarchy by clicking: cut branches, reroot, or pick a subset of leaves and export it together with the matching rows of a linked dataset
features.specific: Tree panel modes: scissors (click a branch to prune it), reroot mode (click a branch; a hover readout shows branch length), and extract-subtree mode (click leaves, see 'n/6 leaves selected', press Go, then answer the 'Extract corresponding sub-MSAs?' dialog).
steps: choose a mode (prune, reroot or extract)
click branches or leaves on the tree
for extraction, check the 'n/6 leaves selected' counter and press Go
accept extraction of linked sub-MSAs
a new subset tree and subset alignment panel appear
serves_tasks: Extract a subset of taxa and their sequences
Remove an outlier taxon from a tree
Reroot a tree on a chosen branch

features.name: In-browser FastME tree building with model options
features.general: Pick a distance model and clustering method in a dialog and build a tree from aligned sequences without a server
features.specific: The FastME Options dialog (opens with F84 and BIONJ preselected) offers Substitution Model (p-distance, RY, JC69, K2P, F81, F84, TN93, LogDet), Tree Inference Method (NJ, BIONJ, UNJ, TaxAdd_BalME, TaxAdd_OLSME), Gamma alpha, NNI/SPR topology optimisation and Bootstraps. Build Tree spawns a linked tree panel, which takes the alignment's base name (vertebrate_gene.nwk) and can be confused with an uploaded tree of the same name.
steps: press Build phylogenetic tree FastME
choose substitution model
choose inference method (optionally gamma, NNI/SPR, bootstraps)
press Build Tree
the new linked tree panel appears
serves_tasks: Infer a tree from the alignment with a chosen model and method

features.name: Distance matrix heatmap with tree round-trip
features.general: Compute pairwise distances, view them as a recolourable square or triangle heatmap with value tooltips, and cluster them back into a tree
features.specific: The MSA distance menu (Normalized Hamming or a FastME model) or the tree's patristic button opens a .phy heatmap. Its controls are High/Low colours with Invert, a square/triangle switch, cell tooltips such as 'Chimpanzee:Chicken 0.3016', and 'Build tree from distances' (Neighbor-Joining).
steps: request distances from the alignment (choose model) or from a tree
hover cells for pair and value
change palette or invert it
switch to triangle view
press Build tree from distances to get an NJ tree
serves_tasks: Compute a pairwise distance matrix from the alignment
Turn a tree into a distance matrix and rebuild a tree from it

features.name: Per-site data chart with column choice, log scale and table view
features.general: Plot a per-position measurement as bars, choose which columns to plot, switch to log scale or a table, and link positions back to the source
features.specific: Data/histogram panels (omega.csv, stats_codon.csv, uploaded TSV) have X/Y column dropdowns, a log toggle, a chart/table toggle, '0/1' to switch 0- or 1-based indexing for linking, plus download and link buttons. An uploaded table needs a header row; without one the first data row becomes the column names.
steps: open the per-codon chart (Predict Omega or site statistics)
choose the Y column (e.g., conservation or gap_fraction)
toggle log scale
toggle table view
hover a codon in the linked alignment to highlight its bar
serves_tasks: Predict per-codon selection pressure
Summarize conservation and gaps per site
Load a precomputed distance matrix and a per-taxon numeric table

features.name: Alignment viewer with colour schemes, codon mode and motif search
features.general: Inspect aligned sequences with switchable colouring, group columns into reading-frame triplets, and search for a position or motif with next/previous match navigation
features.specific: MSA panel has a color-scheme menu (Default, Purine Pyrimidine, Gc), Toggle codon mode (hover shows 'Codon n'), Search site or motif (e.g., GGCAAG, 1/2 with ‹ ›) and reorder (Alphabetical/Reverse).
steps: pick a colour scheme
toggle codon mode
hover to read codon/site
open search and type a motif or site number
step through matches
serves_tasks: Load a sequence alignment and look at conservation, gaps and ambiguous calls
Find a motif or site in the alignment
Reorder the sequences in an alignment

features.name: Structure viewer with linked residue distance map
features.general: Show a 3D molecule, compute its residue-residue distance matrix, and hover a matrix cell to mark both residues in 3D
features.specific: Structure panel (Upload PDB / Search PDB) with 'Generate residue distance matrix'. Hovering a cell (A:10:A:2, 30.4) puts red spheres on residues 10 and 2 of chain A. The small test peptide rendered only as a thin bar in the 3D view.
steps: upload a PDB file
press Generate residue distance matrix
hover a cell in the linked heatmap
see the two residues marked in the 3D view
serves_tasks: Build a residue distance map and see where a pair sits in 3D

features.name: Tree layout and branch-length rendering
features.general: Switch a tree between radial, rectangular and unrooted layouts and between topology-only and branch-length-scaled drawing with a scale bar
features.specific: The tree eye menu offers Radial/Rectangular/Unrooted. The Draw Branch Lengths toggle (pencil icon, tooltip 'Draw ignoring branch lengths') switches scaled drawing and shows a scale bar.
steps: press the Draw Branch Lengths toggle
open the layout menu
choose Rectangular (or Unrooted)
hover leaves, which stay linked
serves_tasks: Change how a tree is drawn

features.name: Board persistence: restore last session and save to file
features.general: Recover the whole workspace after a reload and export layout, data and links to a JSON file
features.specific: After a reload the welcome screen offers 'Restore Board'. Save Board downloads mseaboard.json with panels, layout, panelData and links.
steps: reload the page
press Restore Board
press Save Board
read the downloaded mseaboard.json
serves_tasks: Recover the session after a crash and save it to a file

features.name: Spawn linked analysis panels from an alignment
features.general: Generate derived views of aligned sequences (translation, sequence logo, per-site statistics, selection-pressure predictions, colour matrix, distances), each opening as a new panel already linked to its source
features.specific: MSA toolbar buttons: translate (vertebrate_gene.aa.fasta), Predict Omega (vertebrate_gene_omega.csv), Create sequence logo (.sl.png), site statistics (.stats_codon.csv), Create alignment color matrix (.colors.tsv) and the distance menu (.phy). Hovering the source MSA highlights the matching site in each derived panel without manual linking.
steps: press a derived-analysis button on the alignment panel
pick options if a menu appears (e.g., distance model)
the new panel opens beside the source
hover the source alignment to see the derived panel highlight
serves_tasks: Translate DNA to protein and spot the ambiguous codon
Predict per-codon selection pressure
Summarize conservation and gaps per site
Make a colour-matrix overview of an alignment
Follow one site through all derived views
